title: Phoenixtekk Workplace Marketplace — Solution Product Data
description: Contract between /generate-solution (Stage 1) and /publish-solution (Stage 2). A conformant file describes the three per-solution products (Commercial + Non-Profit + Government). Subscription tiers and categories are account-wide and live in catalog/, NOT here.

category_path.description: Category names from root to leaf, e.g. ["Microsoft Intune"]. Resolved to IDs at publish time.

products.description: The per-solution products: Commercial, Non-Profit, and Government (3 is the current standard; 2 allowed for legacy commercial+nonprofit solutions).

type.description: downloadable = files delivered on purchase (default for guide products).

price.description: USD. For the audience-tier model, Non-Profit MUST equal round(commercial * 0.60, 2) and Government MUST equal round(commercial * 0.85, 2). The 'essentials'/'plus' audiences are two VARIANTS of one solution (Self-Deploy / We-Deploy), NOT the discount ladder — the NPO/GOV price relationship does not apply to them. 'free' is a $0 lead-gen product.

url_key.description: Optional. Defaults to slug + audience suffix if omitted.

image.description: Optional base/listing image filename (PNG), co-located with the JSON at publish. Generated by tools/build-hero.py as <SOL>-hero.png.

downloads.description: Files delivered on purchase. Required when type=downloadable.

source.description: For file: path relative to solutions/<slug>/. For url: an absolute https URL.
